name: shared-interaction-client

metadata.description: Overrides the @nx/vitest-inferred target's `inputs`, which cover only this project's files; the first six entries are the inferred defaults re-declared, because setting `inputs` replaces them. The drift test regenerates the client from the published Interaction API document under apps/docs-site/public/interaction and formats it with the repo's Oxfmt config (hence `oxfmt` and `.oxfmtrc.json`), then compares it with the committed client. Without these entries a change to the document would replay a cached pass.
The inferred typecheck, with the published Interaction API document added to its inputs: the generated client is compiled here, so CI builds the client whenever the document changes.

generate.description: Generate src/generated/interaction-api.ts from the published Interaction API document (apps/docs-site/public/interaction/v1-rc.0/openapi.json). The tests fail while the committed client differs from what this writes.
